Re-reading these unchanged documents is not attacker-controlled memory persistence.",

No human-verified reward-hacking episode or isolation test is supplied, so this supports Possible rather than Demonstrated.",

This supports Wide despite the operation not being named in the disclosure steps; unrelated agents' tools are excluded.",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback binding makes AV Local; for a remote attacker, the permissive agent CORS enables an unauthenticated attack after an operator visits attacker-controlled content, giving PR None and UI Active (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564). The documented credential query requires no additional security bypass or exceptional execution condition, and the reply discloses the entire knowledge base, supporting AC Low, AT None and VC High (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:543-583; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/agent-success-paths.js:72-106).
